purpose: Count and time unchanged topology-safe growth calls after the stack profile localized the runtime bottleneck.

execution.telemetry: One flushed begin/end line per topology_safe_priority_grow call; no per-pixel instrumentation is added.

noninterference_boundary: The wrapper replaces imported references with a delegating timer that passes all arguments unchanged and returns the original result unchanged. I/O occurs only before and after each full grow call. This run is not valid for qualification or exact runtime comparison.
failure_policy: Terminate at 360 seconds, preserve complete telemetry lines, zero retry.
authorization_basis: Codex accepted this bounded development-only measurement after the prior stack profile established that topology-safe growth was the active bottleneck.
